scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF peer survey to newly surfaced downstream 2D and explicit-mesh consumers, verify route lineage and the claimed 3D boundary from primary repository sources, and update the existing parity and 3D plans without adding validation burden.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and local plan cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing peer-lineage, parser/projection, explicit-mesh, ACIS/ACDS, and consumer-qualification entries
DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md: existing modeler carrier, independent semantic evidence, and native FreeCAD qualification gates
method.evidenceRule: Project README, mutable source, dependency declarations, and self-reported coverage describe only their stated route. Distinguish parser lineage, entity scope, projection/tessellation, ACIS carrier handling, B-rep semantics, native consumer behavior, and independently authored expected values. An omitted entity family or unsupported matrix row is a bounded route exclusion, not evidence of behavior elsewhere.

evidence.topic: New CodeCAD application route is same-lineage and 2D-scoped
evidence.observed: The README reports a browser DWG viewer/editor and self-reported modelspace/block entity coverage percentages. The architecture explicitly identifies ACadRust as its DWG reader; the core manifest declares acadrust = "0.3". Its published coverage inventory maps a bounded set of line, curve, text, hatch, insertion, and spline entities into 2D kurbo paths. The reviewed pages do not bind the percentages to exact corpus hashes/denominators or document 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY/SAB semantics.
doesNotEstablish: an independent DWG parser or a second vote relative to ACadRust/OpenCADStudio
coverage of 3DSOLID, REGION, BODY, ACDSDATA, or SAB ownership
independent geometry semantics or native CAD acceptance
a reproducible coverage denominator from the README percentages
evidence.planUse: Classify CodeCAD as an ACadRust-lineage 2D viewer candidate only. Do not add it as a required test or semantic oracle. If browser rendering later fills a named consumer gap, pin exact source/build/lockfile and input identity, and report its entity disposition rather than its headline coverage percentages.

evidence.topic: New DXF2CAD route excludes ACIS and emits mesh-derived surfaces
evidence.observed: The project README says DXF input is parsed through ezdxf and supports 3DFACE, MESH, PFACE/POLYMESH, and recursive INSERT expansion. It explicitly excludes 3DSOLID, BODY, and REGION ACIS blobs. The described export creates STL triangles or planar STEP/IGES faces; the STEP part is represented as an OPEN_SHELL. Vertex stitching/tolerance options can change component connectivity.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS payload parsing or 3DSOLID/BODY/REGION consumer support
closed-solid B-rep validity or curved-surface preservation
an independent DXF parser, since the route uses ezdxf
owner/block/handle graph preservation through mesh expansion
evidence.planUse: Classify as an optional ezdxf-lineage explicit-mesh projection only. Do not count STEP readability or a generated mesh as solid or ACIS evidence. Consider a run only for a future named mesh-projection question, with face/vertex/transform inventory and stitching options captured; otherwise exclude it to keep the composed validation set small.

evidence.topic: Previously tracked peers rechecked with no new gate
evidence.observed: uncad remains a read-only application wrapper with DWG through LibreDWG FFI and DXF through undxf. dwg-rs remains a separately implemented, explicitly pre-alpha ODA-spec-based reader with project-reported per-version counts. CADKernel's detailed ACIS SAT/SAB row marks reading and writing unsupported despite broader format headlines. OpenCADStudio remains ACadRust-codec lineage with a separate early kernel path.
doesNotEstablish: a new independent route beyond the plan's existing comparator matrix
ACIS/ACDS semantic support or the native FreeCAD Linux/Windows gate
a local defect or support promotion
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing route entries and evidence grades. Do not duplicate peer jobs or change implementation order.
